canonical_project: ICS Arabia Desert Dragon Data Center Phase 1 (Al Kharj)
owner: ICS Arabia (Desert Dragon, with China Mobile International and Lumaotong Group)
notes: Phase 1 of the 187 MW national Desert Dragon program is a 64-65 MW Tier III data center located in Al Kharj Industrial City (MODON), Riyadh region, per Blackridge Research and the project engineer's public profile; construction started November 2024 with first phase expected operational around March 2026. Baxtel lists the facility (year built 2026) as ICS Arabia Riyadh / Desert Dragon project. Later phases are in Jeddah, Dammam and NEOM (outside this division).
